# DynamicSupervisor Proxy v0.1.71 - Table of Contents

> Starts a module-based dynamic supervisor process with a registered name.
Will wait a bit if the supervisor name is still registered on restarts.

## Modules

- [DynamicSupervisor.Proxy](https://dynamic-supervisor-proxy.hexdocs.pm/DynamicSupervisor.Proxy.md): Starts a module-based dynamic supervisor process with a registered name.
Will wait a bit if the supervisor name is still registered on restarts.
See [Supervisor restart backoff](https://github.com/erlang/otp/pull/1287).

- [DynamicSupervisor.Proxy.Log](https://dynamic-supervisor-proxy.hexdocs.pm/DynamicSupervisor.Proxy.Log.md)
- [DynamicSupervisor.Proxy.Starter](https://dynamic-supervisor-proxy.hexdocs.pm/DynamicSupervisor.Proxy.Starter.md)
